comment: The targets release.yml builds, declared ONCE: the matrix job derives what the rpm and deb builds and the install-and-qualify job read from this (tools/release-matrix.mjs). Drop a target here and its install cell goes with it. The install cells are the first architecture of each target. The full matrix (Open-Mixer/.github release-matrix full.txt, owner ruling 2026-11-26): every package in every cell; plugin-hostd ships amd64 and arm64 debs since 0.22.4.
